verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const mig=fs.readFileSync("supabase/migrations/20270345005800_space_circle_auto_enrol.sql","utf8");if(!mig.includes("create table if not exists public.space_circle_optouts"))fail("no decline memory, so leaving a Space Circle would not stick");if(!/from public\.space_circle_optouts o/.test(mig))fail("enrolment does not consult the declines");const cut=fs.readFileSync("supabase/migrations/20270346029500_space_circle_cutover.sql","utf8");for(const t of ["space_memberships_enrol_space_circle","memberships_space_circle_optout"])if(!new RegExp("^drop trigger if exists "+t,"m").test(cut))fail("the Space Circle retirement (ADR-1938) does not drop "+t+", so members could still be enrolled into a retired Circle");const t=fs.readFileSync("supabase/tests/space_circle_cutover.test.sql","utf8");if(!t.includes("an active Space membership puts its member on no Circle"))fail("no test holds that a Space membership enrols nobody after the retirement")'
verify.note: Space Circle auto-enrol, as built and as retired by ADR-1938.

append.detail: Pin rewrite 2026-11-04 (ADR-1938, LIVE-2080): Space Circles are retired, so their auto-enrol is too. The probe keeps the original opt-out migration checks and now measures the retirement: the cutover drops both roster triggers and a test holds that a Space membership enrols nobody. The on/off switch, its roster sweep and the old enrol test suite are gone.
